title: Book 1 — Clio, Chapter 6
paragraphs: Croesus was a Lydian by race, the son of Alyattes, and ruler of the nations that live this side of the river Halys — the river that flows from the south between the Syrians and the Paphlagonians and runs out northward into the sea called the Euxine. This Croesus was the first of the barbarians we know of to subdue certain Hellenes and force them to pay tribute, while others he won over as friends. Those he subdued were the Ionians, Aeolians, and Dorians who live in Asia; those he made his friends were the Lacedaemonians. Before the reign of Croesus, all the Hellenes had been free, for the Cimmerian invasion of Ionia, which came before his time, had not been a conquest of the cities but only a raid for plunder.
